content:
The HWPX report generation failed because modified paragraphs retained stale layout cache elements, causing a regression in verifier rewards.
The test 'test_modified_paragraphs_do_not_keep_layout_cache' failed with an AssertionError because 'hp:linesegarray' was still present in modified paragraphs. This indicates that while text insertion worked, the script failed to strip the layout cache from 'section0.xml'. Avoid assuming that simple text replacement is sufficient; the verifier explicitly requires that 'paragraph.find("hp:linesegarray", NS) is None' for any paragraph containing modified fragments.
